title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Corporate)
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. We are looking for a talented Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist to support our continued global expansion. This role will focus on hiring across a diverse range of functions, including Marketing, Payments, Financial Products, Operations, and other business-critical teams. Experience recruiting for traditional financial services roles is highly preferred. The ideal candidate will have experience recruiting across multiple business functions and be comfortable partnering with hiring managers and business leaders in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Ultimately, the Talent Acquisition Specialist will be responsible for attracting, engaging, and hiring top talent while building strong relationships with stakeholders and maintaining a healthy talent pipeline to support current and future hiring needs.
